# Jawla (جولة)

> Bilingual (Arabic/English) field-sales CRM/ERP for the Egyptian market. Reps use the PWA to visit customers with GPS, sell from van stock, collect payments, and record returns. Admins manage master data via a Filament dashboard. Built with Laravel 13, Livewire 3, Filament 4, PostgreSQL 16.

This system implements a complete sales cycle: route assignment → daily visits → cash sales with on-the-spot invoicing → payment collection → returns handling → expense logging. All money and stock mutations happen inside `DB::transaction()` via dedicated service classes. The codebase follows strict engineering rules: no secrets in frontend, no shell execution, pagination everywhere, RTL from day one.
